about: Which AI model does which job (bullet, dated). Copied from the legacy router (rules/ai_models.json, 11 Nov 2026: 'model bhi vo choose karo jo sabse zada capable ho or fit ho'). Tiers: fast for quick classification, balanced for answers, deep for the slow evening note. 'model' is the Claude Code alias (your Claude plan on the Mac), 'api_model' the Claude API model (if an API key is saved instead). budget_per_day caps automatic use; a question you ask is never refused for budget but is counted. If a model is not on your plan, the next one in 'fallback' is tried and remembered for the day.
